blockingIssues.description: Sync endpoint fetches only one Strava activities page (`per_page=100`) with no pagination loop, so it does not fetch all athlete activities as required.
Trip sync call is hardcoded to `http://localhost:5001/api/strava/sync` instead of the required `/api/strava/sync` route contract.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Fail handoff procedure checks when `followedProcedure=true` but required manual `interactiveChecks` are missing for features with UI/manual verification requirements.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: trip-list-ui review found no interactive checks recorded in handoff despite the skill requiring manual verification evidence.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit frontend API-call convention: client code must call relative `/api/...` routes and must not hardcode `localhost` hosts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: trip-list-ui implemented `fetch('http://localhost:5001/api/strava/sync')`, violating the feature contract and environment-port assumptions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Prevent marking a feature completed unless `completedWorkerSessionId`, transcript skeleton, and handoff artifacts all exist and are internally consistent.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: strava-oauth-and-sync is marked completed while `completedWorkerSessionId` is null and no matching transcript/handoff artifact exists for the assigned worker session.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document Strava list-endpoint pagination expectation (iterate pages until empty) when requirements state 'fetch all activities'.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: strava-oauth-and-sync used a single `per_page=100` request without page iteration and failed the all-activities requirement.
